assertions.description: setMicrophoneActive() returns a promise (Chrome 158 / current spec), not undefined (as shipped in Chrome 93). This is the feature's actual contract, listed first so the auto-selected support probe derives from it rather than from the pre-existing interface.
assertions.test: (() => { if (!navigator.mediaSession || typeof navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive !== 'function') return false; const r = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (r && typeof r.catch === 'function') r.catch(() => {}); return !!r && typeof r.then === 'function'; })()

assertions.description: setCameraActive() returns a promise (Chrome 158 / current spec), not undefined (as shipped in Chrome 93).
assertions.test: (() => { if (!navigator.mediaSession || typeof navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive !== 'function') return false; const r = navigator.mediaSession.setCameraActive(false); if (r && typeof r.catch === 'function') r.catch(() => {}); return !!r && typeof r.then === 'function'; })()

assertions.description: navigator.mediaSession is exposed on Window (pre-existing Chrome 93 surface the change rides on; a script assertion so it is never auto-selected as this feature's support probe).
setMicrophoneActive() is a function on the media session (pre-existing Chrome 93 surface).
setCameraActive() is a function on the media session (pre-existing Chrome 93 surface).
In a fully active document the returned promise resolves with undefined, per the update capture state algorithm.
assertions.test: (async () => { const r = navigator.mediaSession.setMicrophoneActive(false); if (!(r instanceof Promise)) return false; return (await r) === undefined; })()

assertions.description: Called on a media session whose document is not fully active (removed iframe), the method returns a promise rejected with InvalidStateError. The promise comes from the iframe's realm, so the check is thenable-based, never `instanceof Promise` against this realm.
assertions.test: (async () => { const f = document.createElement('iframe'); f.src = 'about:blank'; f.style.display = 'none'; f.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true'); document.body.append(f); const s = f.contentWindow.navigator.mediaSession; if (!s || typeof s.setMicrophoneActive !== 'function') { f.remove(); return false; } const m = s.setMicrophoneActive.bind(s); f.remove(); let r; try { r = m(true); } catch { return false; } if (!r || typeof r.then !== 'function') return false; try { await r; return false; } catch (e) { return !!e && e.name === 'InvalidStateError'; } })()
